Transcend

A free, dual-academy learning platform from Sourcefit that teaches practical AI and the human skills that make it useful, then connects graduates with employers.

Role
Web & UI Design
Platform
Website
Year
2026
Client
Sourcefit

The brief

Most AI training stops at a certificate. Sourcefit wanted Transcend to prepare people for work that already uses AI, built from real operations and backed by a global staffing company with direct access to hiring managers. The site had to explain two academies, a five-phase path and an employer network, and make a free platform feel credible enough to start today.

What I designed

I designed the website around one direct question, “AI is already part of the job. Are you ready?”, and a bright gradient accent that runs from the headline through the whole page. It moves from a three-step path (enroll, certify, get visible) to the two academies, why Transcend is different, the learning phases and outcomes, then proof that the content comes from real work. It closes with FAQs and a clear way in. Bold dark sections give each part of the story its own space.
